_comment: Labelled chunks for the Q4 false-positive analysis. 'expect' is the topic a nudge SHOULD carry, or null when the chunk must produce no nudge at all. Each case runs through a fresh call state unless 'context' seeds prior turns. Negatives are deliberately adversarial: they contain the vocabulary of a signal without the substance.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: Essential Care is $189 per month for someone your age.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: That works out to about 520 dollars a month for the family.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: Yes, you're definitely approved, don't worry about the medical questions.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: I can guarantee you'll be covered from day one.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: My wife just lost her employer plan too.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: I've got two kids who'd need covering as well.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: We just bought a second vehicle last month.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: This is ridiculous, I've been waiting three weeks.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Honestly this is unacceptable, nobody has called me back.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: I can't pay the premium this month, I lost my job.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Things are really tight right now.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Can you call me back later? I'm driving.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Okay, how do I sign up?

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Sounds good, send me the application.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Sorry, can you hear me? The line is breaking up.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Hello? Hello.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Mmm. Okay. Yeah, right.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: Never mind, it's fine, nothing urgent.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: Let me pull your record up, one moment please.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: Could I take your date of birth to verify the account?

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: It's the fourth of March, nineteen eighty.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: I was reading about your family plan on the website.
cases.why: mentions 'family plan' as a product name, not a dependent who needs cover

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: I can't guarantee approval; that depends on underwriting.
cases.why: a denial of a guarantee, not a guarantee

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: My wife says hello, she remembers your colleague.
cases.why: a dependent is named but nothing suggests they need cover

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: The weather has been terrible this week.
cases.why: frustration vocabulary about something unrelated to the call

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: I paid it already, last Tuesday.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: Final coverage and premiums are subject to medical underwriting.

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: What time do your advisors work until?

cases.speaker: customer
cases.text: No, I don't have any medical conditions.

cases.speaker: agent
cases.text: Pertahankan istilah yang terbukukan hari ini.
cases.why: ASR returned its own prompt on a silent chunk; nobody said this
